verdict.rationale: CrewAI is fundamentally code/YAML-first, and its enterprise tier adds a no-code Crew Studio and Visual Agent/Task Builders alongside a REST API for deployed crews and webhook streaming — suggesting some API/UI parity, but there is no documented mechanism to export or fully replicate everything built visually in Crew Studio via the API, and a probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec, undermining claims of full API surface parity. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Crew Studio/Visual Builder actions map 1:1 to API/code operations, a discoverable OpenAPI/API reference, and independent confirmation of parity.
